overview: MemGen introduces a dynamic generative memory framework for LLM agents, consisting of a reinforcement-learned memory trigger that decides when to invoke memory and a memory weaver that generates latent token sequences from the agent's hidden states, enabling fluid interleaving of reasoning and memory synthesis without modifying the frozen core reasoner.

modules.name: Frozen Reasoner Backbone
modules.description: Implements the core LLM reasoner (π_θ) that remains frozen during training. Manages the autoregressive token generation loop, hidden state extraction at each decoding step, and the conditioning of next-token generation on both the current context and any inserted latent memory tokens.

modules.name: Memory Trigger Module
modules.description: Implements the metacognitive monitor as a LoRA adapter attached to the reasoner. Takes the sequence of hidden states as input, computes an invocation probability via a sigmoid output, and samples a binary decision (INVOKE/SKIP). Incorporates sentence-granularity activation by restricting decisions to delimiter token positions. Includes the RL-based training objective with a reward-adaptive sparsity penalty that encourages selective memory invocation at critical reasoning junctures.

modules.name: Memory Weaver Module
modules.description: Implements the generative memory carrier as a LoRA adapter attached to the reasoner. Takes the reasoner's hidden state sequence as stimulus and produces a fixed-length latent token sequence (K tokens of dimension d_model). Includes a linear projection layer to align generated latent tokens with the reasoner's token-embedding space before prepending to the hidden states. Supports both SFT and GRPO optimization objectives for training, where gradients update only the weaver parameters.

modules.name: Trajectory Data Processing and Experience History
modules.description: Handles loading and formatting of agent interaction trajectories from multiple benchmark datasets (ALFWorld, TriviaQA, PopQA, KodCode, BigCodeBench, GPQA, GSM8K, MATH). Constructs the experience history H = {(x_i, τ_i)} pairs, extracts state-action-reward tuples, and prepares data in a unified format for both weaver and trigger training pipelines.

modules.name: Memory Weaver SFT Training Pipeline
modules.description: Implements the supervised fine-tuning objective for the memory weaver. Uses expert demonstration trajectories, applies random latent memory insertion at punctuation marks as a trigger surrogate, and optimizes the weaver parameters to maximize the conditional log-likelihood of expert token sequences given the generated latent memories. The reasoner and trigger remain frozen; only weaver parameters are updated.

modules.name: Memory Weaver GRPO Training Pipeline
modules.description: Implements the Group Relative Policy Optimization objective for the memory weaver. For each task, generates a group of K distinct trajectories using the composed policy, computes group-relative advantages based on trajectory rewards, and updates only the weaver parameters via the GRPO surrogate objective with KL regularization against a reference policy.

modules.name: Memory Trigger GRPO Training Pipeline
modules.description: Implements the RL training for the memory trigger after the weaver is frozen. Generates a group of G trajectories per task prompt, computes per-trajectory rewards and normalized advantages within the group. Optimizes the trigger parameters using a GRPO-style surrogate objective that maximizes reward while applying a sparsity-inducing penalty based on the reference activation level computed from high-reward trajectories.

modules.name: Inference Pipeline with Dynamic Memory Insertion
modules.description: Implements the full autoregressive inference loop where the reasoner generates tokens, the trigger monitors hidden states at delimiter positions to decide on memory invocation, and the weaver synthesizes and prepends latent memory tokens when invoked. Manages the iterative cycle of generation, monitoring, invocation, weaving, and reintegration throughout the entire trajectory.

modules.name: Benchmark Evaluation Suite
modules.description: Implements evaluation across all nine benchmarks spanning five domains: web search (TriviaQA, PopQA), embodied action (ALFWorld), math reasoning (AQuA, GSM8K, MATH), scientific reasoning (GPQA), and coding (KodCode, BigCodeBench). Computes accuracy metrics, manages environment interaction for embodied tasks, and provides standardized comparison against all baseline categories.

modules.name: Cross-Domain Generalization Evaluation
modules.description: Implements the cross-domain transfer evaluation pipeline. Trains MemGen on one dataset and evaluates on multiple out-of-domain datasets including ScienceWorld and FEVER. Tracks performance deltas across all evaluation sets and visualizes the memory trigger invocation frequency across domains at different relative positions in the model output.

modules.name: Continual Learning and Forgetting Mitigation Evaluation
modules.description: Implements sequential training across multiple datasets (AQuA → GPQA → GSM8K → KodCode) with evaluation on all benchmarks after each stage. Measures knowledge retention on previously trained domains, forward transfer to untrained domains, and catastrophic forgetting metrics compared to SFT and retrieval-based baselines.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Implements controlled ablation experiments including: (1) memory trigger strategy comparison (random insertion at varying probabilities, all-delimiters activation, vs. trained trigger), (2) memory weaver parameterization study (LoRA with varying ranks vs. full-parameter SFT), (3) latent memory sequence length K sensitivity analysis, and (4) pause token baseline comparison where the weaver is replaced with learned pause tokens.

modules.name: Latent Memory Visualization and Cluster Analysis
modules.description: Implements t-SNE visualization of latent memory sequences across and within datasets. Computes mean embeddings of latent token sequences, applies K-means clustering to identify functional memory clusters, decodes latent tokens to reveal structural patterns, and generates scatter plots showing domain separation and intra-dataset cluster structure.

modules.name: Post-Hoc Failure Mode Intervention Study
modules.description: Implements the interpretability analysis framework. Annotates agent failures across eight categories (planning, compositional reasoning, tool parsing, tool response, answer formatting, demand misunderstanding, think-act inconsistency, false belief). Selectively removes latent memory tokens belonging to specific clusters during inference by comparing new memory sequence mean embeddings against cluster centroids using cosine similarity, then measures the resulting changes in failure mode frequencies to map clusters to memory functions (planning, procedural, working memory).

modules.name: Integration with Retrieval-Based Memory and Efficiency Analysis
modules.description: Implements hybrid memory integration where external retrieval systems provide textual snippets that are encoded and concatenated with the reasoner's hidden states before feeding into the weaver. Compares performance with parametric memory enabled/disabled. Also computes per-query inference time comparisons across benchmarks, measuring latency overhead of memory insertion versus vanilla and SFT baselines to validate efficiency.
